node.title: AQB finite deficit arithmetic
node.statement: For N=2^40, d=4,296,456,369, m=2^39+d, and Q<=256, the finite AQB deficit B_I=dQ-40-log2 C(N,m) is maximized at Q=256 and is strictly less than 429,645,547 bits; equivalently the recorded averaged-gain target clears the finite arithmetic deficit, with Qcrit=255.900000020976...
node.attack_surface: finite arithmetic only; certified by Robbins Stirling interval bounds in nodes/aqb_averaged_quotient_box/verify.py
node.falsifier: a certified interval computation placing B_I(256) at or above 429,645,547 bits
